# Wormholes — JTGravity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Euclidean wormhole JT”).

claims.name: jackiw_teitelboim_jt_gravity_setup
claims.statement: A Jackiw–Teitelboim (JT) gravity setup exhibits a Euclidean wormhole to black hole phase transition at finite charge density and/or chemical potential.

sources.title: Phases of Euclidean wormholes in JT gravity

claims.name: semiclassical_negativity_hawking_radiation_requires
claims.statement: Semi-classical negativity of Hawking radiation requires island contributions, and this is verified in JT gravity through the Euclidean wormhole origin of these contributions.

sources.title: Negativity Spectra in Random Tensor Networks and Holography

claims.name: study_identifies_firstorder_phase_transition
claims.statement: The study identifies a first-order phase transition in a Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity setup from a low-temperature charged Euclidean wormhole to a two-black hole system at finite charge density.

sources.title: Phases of Euclidean wormholes in JT gravity
